title: Lymphocyte-to-C-reactive protein ratio as a clinically feasible nutrition-inflammation marker for predicting outcomes in patients with gastric cancer.
caption: Forest plot illustrating the pooled effect estimates evaluating the relationship between pretreatment lymphocyte-to-C-reactive protein ratio and overall survival in individuals with gastric cancer. HR, hazard ratio; CI, confidence interval.
